skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the fundamental and advanced concepts of technology and technology management at both micro and macro levels.
Analyze and evaluate scientific and technological activities at micro and macro levels.
Implement technology management activities independently and adapt to changes.
Demonstrate leadership and teamwork skills in group presentations and discussions.
Effectively communicate and present ideas in both written and oral formats.
Conduct research and analyze technological capabilities using quantitative methods.
Understand and apply models of technological innovation and improvement.
Adhere to professional ethics and social responsibility.
Manage technology transfer and adoption processes.
Develop strategic plans for technology management in organizations.
